avis.titre: Takes a little time, like any OTC retinoid, but it's incredible.Takes a little time, like any OTC retinoid, but it's inc
avis.texte: I was a retinoid latecomer, in fact a latecomer to skincare as a whole, not doing anything special until I was 40. By then some damage had already appeared in the form of noticeably thinning skin (I saw capillaries scattered around my face, and this made me look older than any other sign of aging I was experiencing), fine lines, and discolored spots. I wanted to get on the strongest things I could as soon as possible. I began with The Ordinary's Granactive Retinoid 2% emulsion, because I'd read it was a beginner-friendly gentle option, but I had the goal of jumping to this retinaldehyde emulsion all along. I'm not 28, after all! (I need to emphasize that middle-aged and older women will see more benefits from strong retinoids like this than younger women, like under 35. Y'all have good enough skin that the changes you'll see are less extreme than what we'll see.) My skin is not sensitive, so I was able to upgrade to this retinal just 6 months after using the granactive. I now use it 6 nights out of 7 with no irritation. The 7th night is exfoliation. I'm not saying everyone will be able to do that, but this is gentle enough - in contrast with conventional retinol - that you might. I have somewhat oily skin, which helps; I expect it'd be drying otherwise, and I do have to put on extra moisturizer in the winter. (But don't we all?) I also apply sunscreen to my face every single day without exception. If you use retinoids and you don't do that, you'll regret it and you won't see

I've used The Ordinary products for years. Mostly just the basic skin care like for cleanser, serum and moisturizer, and Ive always loved it. Everything is great and its always reliable. And affordable! I am 39 with skin thats starting to show signs of aging but still a pretty prevalent acne issue. Its hard dealing with both because different areas of my face needed vastly different things. I was on trentinoin for years. While it worked excellent, its expensive. $65/m for just the trentinoin, not including all the other skincare. I have been trying to cut my budget down (who isnt?), and it had to go. Some retinol formulations I have tried are extremely expensive and really honestly not effective. I figured that The Ordinary has been a mainstay in my skincare for years now, so I may as well try it and if it doesnt work it's not like I wasted a ton of money. This stuff is AMAZING. I mean... I really want to say it's more effective than my trentinoin. I have been using retinol and trentinoin for about 12 years now. The formulation of this is excellent. It will purge your skin when you start. That's how you know its working. Once the initial phase works through, and with consistent application, you WILL see a massive difference. Even instantly after application it improve the look and feel of my skin, but the lasting effects come with consistent use. However they formulate this makes is so effective but also makes your skin look and feel great after just applying it. It isn't ove

avis.titre: Great for Cell Turnover and Smoother Under-Eye TextureGreat for Cell Turnover and Smoother Under-Eye Texture
avis.texte: I have been very pleased with this retinal emulsion so far. It has made a noticeable difference in my skin’s overall texture and has especially helped with cell turnover, leaving my complexion looking smoother and more refined. One area where I have seen the biggest improvement is the tiny milia under my eyes, which appear less prominent with continued use. This is definitely a stronger formula, so a little goes a long way. I have noticed it can create a temporary tightening or slightly dry feeling after application, so following with a rich moisturizer is essential. Layering moisturizer on top also helps offset the slight yellow tint this product can leave on the skin immediately after use. Thankfully my skin seems to tolerate it very well with no major irritation, but as with any retinal product, daily SPF is non-negotiable while using it. Overall, this is an effective anti-aging and resurfacing treatment at a very reasonable price point. If you are looking to improve texture, encourage faster skin renewal, and target small stubborn bumps like milia, this is a great addition to a nighttime routine.

Been using this nightly for 12 nights. I have been using generous amounts — 3 full pumps — one each for my face, neck and the backs of my hands. I'm surprised the small quantity in the bottle has lasted this long. Absorption isn't great; it's a very dry formula. I seriously don't know how people get by with "pea sized" amounts. Applying it to damp skin isn't really effective for me as far as assisting with absorption; despite finishing with a damp washcloth, my face is already too dry by the time I reach for the bottle. After applying the retinal, I mist my face with water and it significantly assists with spreadability and absorption. I get a nice tingle, too. As appropriate for retinal, there is no fragrance to note. I pair the retinal with Neutrogena Ultra Gentle moisturizing cream which contains CICA and B5. It's lightweight, sufficiently moisturizing for my dry skin and leaves it supple. Nice texture and absorbs beautifully. The CICA counteracts any irritation I might experience from the retinal, and I got a huge 11 oz jar for $10. It was really a steal. Once my skin adjusts to the retinal, though, I will likely move on to something with niacinamide and peptides. As stated, this is a dry formula so it is totally non-greasy. It's hard to tell how much it has improved my skin thus far, but I am getting lots of flaking which is what I wanted. I have no doubt I will see a significant difference once that outer layer of dead skin cells have all turned over and expect further

The Ordinary Retinal 0.2% Emulsion has been a wonderful addition to my skin care regimen. It is a highly concentrated product and I’ve noticed my skin appearing younger and healthier. I see less fine lines, more even skin and a better complexion over all. I have not had any adverse effects as dryness, redness or irritation present. The product is a reasonable price and lasts a while so it’s worth it.

avis.titre: A solid step up after The Ordinary’s beginner retinalA solid step up after The Ordinary’s beginner retinal
avis.texte: I’d already worked through The Ordinary’s lower-strength retinal products, so this 0.2% felt like a manageable next step rather than a shock. The emulsion is lightweight and absorbs quickly with no greasy residue. Since my skin was already primed, I only noticed slight tightness the first couple of nights, nothing like the flaking first-timers often mention. Within a few weeks, my skin texture looked smoother, tone more even, and fine lines around my eyes softened. Pair it with SPF daily and skip layering with AHA/BHA the same night. Not a starting point if you’ve never used a retinoid, but a great next step once you’ve built up tolerance.

The results, quite frankly, left me astonished. I'm a 32 year old male, cystic acne, oily skin, small pours, large hair follicles. I've been going between different retinoid products for several months now, with decent results. I just recently switched to The Ordinary's Retinal, and here's my experience. This stuff is so good, that even two old chicken pock scars from my childhood are significantly faded. For my skin type, it's perfect. I use a very light weight birch sap moisturizer after applying, along with this company's niacinamide, and it simply works magic. My skin feels smoother, is brighter, and way less prone to breakouts. My face rarely sees anything unless I get razor burn. The only con I can think of is that it stains clothes, and makes you look like you're covered in mustard.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Retinal is something a lot of people don’t include in their skincare routine but can be extremely effective if used properly. This one by The Ordinary should only be applied once or twice a week using a pea sized amount spread throughout the entire face and or target areas. It does leave a yellow cast which is why it should be used toward the end of the day. This has a high retinal % for an over the counter product which is beneficial for those who want to achieve great results without needing to go through the hassles of obtaining a prescription. If you stay consistent, you will absolutely see improvements in skin texture, firmness, and radiance.
I really like this product it seems to be very effective. However it is extremely small so you literally should buy x2 at least

Mi piace molto, basta poco prodotto da spalmare sulla pelle detersa, si assorbe facilmente e non unge. Lo uso da poco ma vedo già la pelle più compatta e luminosa. Per le rughe ormai alla mia età ci vorrebbe un miracolo (o il botox), però questo prodotto aiuta. Da usare con attenzione se si ha la pelle sensibile, è pur sempre retinolo. Peccato la confezione un po' piccola, avrei preferito qualche ml in più, però è molto pratica, con la pompetta si riesce a dosare bene la crema senza sprechi.

I've been using this for about 2 weeks now, 2–3 times a week, and so far it's been okay. It comes in a small pump bottle that's easy to use. The product is yellowish in colour, applies nicely on skin, and although it's only 15 ml, you only need a small amount so it should last a while. Before this, I was using 1% Retinol in Squalane. When I first started using retinol, I had breakouts and peeling even though I introduced it gradually. I was a bit worried about switching to this, but thankfully I've had no redness/peeling, or breakouts so far. My skin doesn't feel dry either. If you're new to retinoids, I'd recommend starting with a lower strength before trying this one. I haven't noticed any dramatic results yet, but it's only been a couple of weeks, and I know these products take time to work.
All the sheets, pyjama are yellow after the use. Horrible. Never happened with any other retinal before.

Ich habe mir anstatt meiner üblichen bekannten Retinal Creme diese von The Ordinary bestellt und bis jetzt mag ich sie sehr gerne. Im Gegensatz zu der anderen Creme hat sie 0,2% Retinal, also 0,1% mehr. Hört sich wenig an, ist aber definitiv bemerkbar. Sie hat im Grunde die selbe Konsistenz und Farbe, nämlich ist sie eher cremig dünnflüssig und gelb. Man benötigt nicht viel Produkt. Bei Retinal muss man unbedingt darauf achten sie nur Abends zu verwenden und am nächsten Tag einen UV-Schutz zu tragen, am besten 50+. Die "The Ordinary Retinal Emulsion" gibt mir einen leichten Glow, beseitigt Unreinheiten und kann bei regelmäßiger Anwendung auch gegen Falten vorbeugen. Auch finde ich, dass sie gewisse Mimikfalten verschwinden lässt.

avis.titre: It feels nice but I’m not sure it sinks in
avis.texte: I’ve been using retinol and retinoids for years so I can’t tell if this is “working” yet. It’s a nice texture and dries pretty quickly. It is yellow in color which is normal, however, when I wake up in the morning and use toner to clean my face, my cotton pad is covered in yellow. Which makes me wonder if this even sinks in. And, if it doesn’t sink in, is it able to work properly? I’m not sure. But I will continue to use until I finish the bottle and see how I feel then.

avis.titre: EXACTLY WHAT I USED TO PAY $90 FOR
avis.texte: If your retinal isn't yellow it isn't going to work because it just isn't retinal. This stuff has only made me kick myself hard in the a** for wasting $90 a pop on my prior retinal. All the money I wasted over the years makes me cringe. I promise you all that I am very experience based educated in skin resurfacing. I had acne scarring and hyperpigmentation issues that were severe on my face and I regularly do chemical peels and have done so for years. I am very familiar with how real genuine retinal acts and feels on the skin. This is the EXACT same think that other companies are charging more than 3 times what this costs. This stuff is a game changer for both my wallet and my face. I have nothing bad to say. Anyone who pays premium pricing is essentially throwing money away for not additional skin benefit because this is the exact same thing you can pay iver $100 on other websites. I get being brand loyal but when it comes down to it, I'm not independently wealthy, I'm actually broke lmao, (it's true, funny, not funny) so every cent spent matters in my world. I just paid the extreme prices because I needed improvement in my skin so I paid those stupidly high prices for years to ensure I got a quality retinal, and though I did get high quality I now realize I could have been getting this and only spending $20 some dollars vs. $100. So mad I didn't find this sooner. Don't do what I did and fall victim to the greedy manufacturers because your just wasting your money if you do.

I've always wanted to incorporate a good retinoid into my skincare routine, and after doing some research, I decided to try The Ordinary's Retinal 0.2% Emulsion. It's been an excellent choice! I apply it at night, after cleansing my face and before applying my moisturizer. I use just a small amount (about the size of a pea) and spread it evenly. At first, I used it only 2-3 times a week to get my skin used to it, and now I apply it every other night. The texture is light and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. It doesn't have a strong fragrance and didn't irritate my skin. After a few weeks, my skin feels smoother, brighter, and less textured. I've also noticed an improvement in the appearance of fine lines. If you're looking for an effective and affordable retinal product, this is a great option. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Gentle but Powerful – My Skin’s Looking So Much Better!
avis.texte: I started using The Ordinary Retinal 0.2% Emulsion about two months ago, and honestly, I’m impressed. I was a bit nervous to try retinal (especially with all the talk about irritation), but this formula has been super gentle on my skin. I eased it in slowly, just a night a week, and now I’m using it consistently — no dryness, no peeling. My skin feels smoother, looks more even, and there’s this glow I didn’t have before. It’s helped fade some texture and early signs of aging, and I love that it feels light but effective. Definitely staying in my routine.

Don't let the small size fool you. I ordered this April 5th (109 days ago) and started with the recommended 2x a week and quickly worked my way up to every other day. Sometimes I'll even use two pumps instead of one. I still haven't used it up! Not only have I gotten tons of uses out of it, but I've also experienced ZERO irritation. I was worried about starting a retinoid because I've heard they can be irritating and take a while to get used to. I haven't had a single issue using this product. My acne disappears almost as soon as it shows up, and I've noticed pretty good improvement in my hyperpigmentation. I'm going to continue using this product for the foreseeable future.

Definitivamente es un producto que cumple lo que promete y que marcó un cambio en mi rutina nocturna. Lo recomiendo al 100% a quienes buscan resultados visibles en el anti-envejecimiento y la textura de la piel. ¡Vale totalmente la pena!
